text: At a parapsychology conference, the medium Helga Ulmann senses [twisted, murderous thoughts|trigger|strange signs and visions] in the audience, and that night a black-gloved figure kills her with a meat cleaver. The English jazz pianist Marcus Daly sees it from the street and is troubled by [a painting that seems to have vanished|images|pictures, screens and recordings] from her apartment. Following [a child's song|rules|death sends warnings] played outside his door, he finds an abandoned house where a hidden mural shows a child holding a bloody knife over [a dead body|origin|harm done in childhood].
